name: smarty-integration/smarty-integration
description: Smarty Integration validates and standardizes US addresses in Shopware 6 using Smarty APIs. It auto-fills city and ZIP and blocks invalid addresses during registration and checkout.

description.en-GB: Smarty Integration validates and standardizes US addresses in Shopware 6 using Smarty APIs. It auto-fills city and ZIP and blocks invalid addresses during registration and checkout.
description.de-DE: Smarty Integration prüft und standardisiert Adressen in Shopware 6 mit Smarty APIs. Es ergänzt Stadt und Postleitzahl und verhindert ungültige Adressen beim Registrieren und Bezahlen.
